prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one independent full-bleed event illustration for a nautical adventure game. Landscape 4:3 composition. Detailed hand-painted painterly realism, confident brushwork, believable weathered wood, bronze, rope, water and cloth. Strong clear main subject readable at 256px thumbnail, rich depth, natural anatomy. Tropical reef sea with bright turquoise blue-green water, dark rocky islets, warm wooden sailing craft, deep blue sky and sunlit clouds unless scene specifies night. Preindustrial age of sail. No text, lettering, logos, UI, title, border, collage, panels, watermark, or modern technology. Make one scene only. A knotted sounding rope descends beside the hull through exceptionally clear turquoise shallow water to a broad sand-covered corroded metal disk on the seabed. Compose compass, rope and disk in one believable perspective, sunlight glitter, subtle ripples. No diagram, no arrows, no magical force lines, no readable numbers.
